text:
andrea: heads-up — our base image `gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-28` flagged a new critical vuln in OpenSSL (CVE-2026-4142). scanner shows RCE vector in libssl.

samir: paste scanner snippet + layer sha pls

andrea: snippet:
```
CVE-2026-4142 | openssl 3.0.7 | RCE | CVSS 9.8
file: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.3
layer sha: sha256:deadbeef...9012
```

maria: even if distro provides it, we should produce a patched base so we control the final artifact (remove package manager, strip symbols, lock file perms). also need extended audit logs for signing + KMS calls during the window.

nathan: KMS note: our signer key is `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/signer-prod`. do NOT disable old key versions while images signed by them are still live. cosign verifies against the keyversion embedded in signature.

security-oncall: suggested immediate runbook:
- block new canaries (set CI flag)
- build patched base in staging applying distro CVE fix + hardening steps
- run smoke + regression (startup, kv cache, p99 token timing)
- sign with current keyversion, produce attestations
- 1% canary for 45m, monitor startup errors, cosign verify, and telemetry alerts
- if clean, ramp; then plan key rotation AFTER images are retired and a 14–30d grace window
owners?

andrea: I'll build and produce cosign logs. kicking now.

ci-bot: build started: staging/base:2026-03-28-patched #4981

samir: I'll open the IAM MR to give CI-SA temporary signer access. MR: `https://gitlab.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/330` — granting `roles/keystore.signer` scoped to the staging signer key only.

maria: I'll file SIEM ticket to extend retention for image-sign and KMS usage from 30d -> 180d for `org:redwood-prod`. linking to INC-810.

security-oncall: policy reminder: do not revoke key versions for at least 14 days after last production images signed by them; prefer 30d. post any revoke intentions in #release-war-room 48h in advance.

andrea: staged image built, cosign attest OK. scheduling canary at 18:45 UTC for 1% traffic. nathan + samir watching. will post cosign verify logs. :thumbsup:

security-oncall: keeping incident open. if any cosign verify failures, KMS DENIED, or unexpected reverts appear, escalate to infra-oncall and tag me.
